purpose: Defines requirements for the orchestrator pattern in forge skills: delegating work to skills and agents, data exchange, document formats, and completion flow, to avoid God-Skill problems.
summary: Background: God-Skill problems of single-context execution (context use, accuracy loss, no parallelism, compression loss)
Target skills: start-design, start-plan, start-implement, start-requirements, review
FNC-001: orchestrators handle progress and user dialogue; document search goes directly to query skills without an intermediate Agent
FNC-003: reference documents given to agents must be self-contained and placed in plugins/forge/docs
FNC-004: parallel-capable structure; agents return results as return values; identifier-plus-script-JSON exchange exception; minimal prompt data
FNC-005: format selection, JSON for machine-parsed plans, Markdown for requirements and designs
FNC-006: common completion flow of review, ToC update via update-db-specs, and commit
FNC-007: user input interpretation is done by AI, not parser scripts; scripts limited to structured data
Applicability table of orchestrator conversion and data exchange method per skill
tasks: Designing or modifying a forge orchestrator skill
Delegating work to custom agents or query skills
Designing data exchange between parallel agents
Choosing document formats for generated documents
Implementing completion processing of document-generating skills
Deciding how to handle user command arguments
title: REQ-001 オーケストレータパターン要件
